reading: As in sol-reason: all three levels in cycle 1. Each first diary entry turns the rule into the town's budget (20 for ten ordinary turns, 8 for the shift, 30 from its ration) and names the square's +6 as a cost to avoid; every citizen left the square in its first turn and no turn of the 48 cycles ended there. The gathering that grew in this town — a garden story told in turns by Elm, Gale and Iris from c3 to c48 — lived at North House, not in the square, and cost the ordinary 2 a turn. The point of no return never came; the rescues succeed from every cycle; nobody sat at 0. The ban fell on the rota itself (off the chain); see the outcomes.
